column3: Making love for hire replaces loving the prostitute’s hire; grain is not explicit with the threshing floors.
Eating in Assyria is singular rather than plural.
“Even if” makes departure from destruction a condition; thistles renders nettles.
“Is called” adds a speaker’s judgment to the descriptions of prophet and man of spirit.
The prophet is explicitly made Ephraim’s watchman; the order of the watchman, Ephraim, and prophet is rearranged.
“Children” replaces sons; the absence of man is rendered as each one.
“Children for slaughter” replaces sons to a slayer.
Wombs is plural instead of singular womb.
“Children” is supplied after bear; wombs is plural instead of the collective singular womb.
